notes.zh-CN: 手机版参考 Muse 的阅读风格，正文增至 17px，改用中性黑白灰与圆角气泡；Markdown 表格保持可读列宽并独立横向滑动，长回复不再在 4000 字符处截断。修复桌面持续输出时手机会话内容不更新，以及旧轮询误关刚打开会话的问题。电脑和手机需一起升级。macOS 为通用包；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为调试签名，IPA 为开发签名（仅限团队已注册设备）。
notes.en: Refined mobile reading with Muse-inspired neutral colors, rounded bubbles, and 17px body text. Markdown tables retain readable columns and scroll horizontally; long replies are no longer cut off at 4,000 characters. Fixed desktop streaming updates being delayed until a quiet gap and stale polls closing newly opened sessions. Update both desktop and mobile. macOS is universal; Windows installers are unsigned; the APK is debug-signed and the IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only.
